On the way to Emmaus, Luke 24. After the cross, two hearts were heavy, and a stranger came beside them, opened Moses and the prophets, and when He broke bread, their eyes were opened, and He vanished, and they said, did not our heart burn within us, while he talked. Jesus truth often starts like a long walk, then becomes certain in a small moment. Read slow with Him, and ask Him to show Himself in the Word.
